verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page notes accounts can be deleted anytime from Settings and that Privacy Mode prevents training on data, giving users some control over data handling, but there is no Bugbot-specific documentation on retention periods, deletion of PR review data/history, or data lifecycle controls tied to the review feature itself. missing for 10: Bugbot-specific retention/deletion policy, granular control over stored review comments/history, independent confirmation of deletion behavior.
